labels.environment: Every node is a dkv-server process on the machine below, with its data on ext4; the load generator runs on the same machine. 16 shards (and the meta group).
labels.event: SIGKILL of the node leading shard 0
labels.title: Leader failover
labels.what: Three nodes, RF 3, workload A; the node leading shard 0 is SIGKILLed 10 s into the measured time. Election timeouts are 0.5-1 s (raft.tick_interval 50 ms, raft.election_ticks 10).
